name: Sweet Amber
label: Quest
description: Sweet Amber: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Amber is the hue of my life's longest love
Like the last embers of dusk in the sky above
Retrieve for me so that my love shall be born
One sack of each: barley, rye and corn.
